glosses: A situation which poses an immediate risk and which requires urgent attention.

examples.text: Cardiac arrest is an emergency requiring medical attention.

examples.text:

glosses: A person brought in at short notice to replace a member of staff, a player in a sporting team, etc.

examples.text:
